Metadata.Name: Incident Management
Metadata.Description: Multi-team incident handling with triage routing, SLA tracking, and optional QC verification. Demonstrates break-fix workflow patterns.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Report Incident
Step.Description: Affected user or reporter fills out the incident intake form.

Step.Title: Triage Assessment
Step.Description: The triage team reviews the incident, assesses priority, and routes to the appropriate support team.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-triage","assigned_group_id":"group-it-triage","description":"Review the reported incident. Assess actual priority, confirm category, and provide initial notes. The workflow will route to the appropriate team based on your selection.","next_step_ids":["step-3"]}

Step.Title: Route by Category
Step.Description: Routes the incident to the appropriate team based on triage assessment.

Step.Title: Network Team Resolution
Step.Description: Network team investigates and resolves the incident.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-implementation","assigned_group_id":"group-network-team","description":"Resolve the network-related incident. Document your actions and resolution details.","next_step_ids":["step-8"]}

Step.Title: Server Team Resolution
Step.Description: Server team investigates and resolves the incident.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-implementation","assigned_group_id":"group-server-team","description":"Resolve the server-related incident. Document your actions and resolution details.","next_step_ids":["step-8"]}

Step.Title: Application Team Resolution
Step.Description: Application team investigates and resolves the incident.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-implementation","assigned_group_id":"group-app-team","description":"Resolve the application-related incident. Document your actions and resolution details.","next_step_ids":["step-8"]}

Step.Title: Triage Team Resolution
Step.Description: Triage team resolves the incident directly without escalation.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-implementation","assigned_group_id":"group-it-triage","description":"Resolve this incident directly. Document your actions and resolution details.","next_step_ids":["step-8"]}

Step.Title: QC Required?
Step.Description: If triage requested QC verification, route to the QC team; otherwise skip to notification.

Step.Title: QC Verification
Step.Description: QC team contacts the affected user to confirm resolution.
Step.Definition: {"form_id":"form-qc","assigned_group_id":"group-qc-team","description":"Contact the affected user to confirm the incident is fully resolved to their satisfaction.","routes":[{"expression":"data['customer_confirmed'] == 'No — Requires Further Action'","target_step_id":"step-2"}],"default_target_step_id":"step-10"}

Step.Title: Notify Resolution
Step.Description: Send resolution notification to the affected user.
Step.Definition:
{"to":"$input.affected_email","subject":"Incident Resolved — $input.issue_description","body":"Your incident has been resolved.

Resolution: $input.resolution_description
Resolution Code: $input.resolution_code

If you have any further questions, please contact the IT Service Desk.","next_step_ids":[]}
